bottleneck.description: World #1 linear motion (LM) guide and ball screw supplier; precision class deeply qualified into semiconductor lithography, machine tool, and high-precision robotics.

dependency.key_customers: ASML, Nikon, Tokyo Electron, Yaskawa, FANUC, semiconductor fab equipment makers, machine tool builders
dependency.key_suppliers: Bearing steel suppliers, precision grinding service providers, ceramic component suppliers

editorial.notes: THK invented the linear motion guide in 1972 and remains global #1 in precision linear guides, with deep qualification into ASML/Nikon lithography, Yaskawa robots, and precision machine tools. While Hiwin, NSK, Bosch Rexroth, Schaeffler, and IKO contest the broader market, THK retains premium-class incumbency in high-precision/semi-grade applications. MEDIUM reflects this qualification stickiness in critical applications while acknowledging viable substitutes exist outside the precision tier.
